title: The broadcast voter model: Stationary measures
summary: The classical voter model is dual to coalescing random walks, in much the same way that the Kingman coalescent describes genealogies through binary mergers. Motivated by the passage from the Kingman to the~\(Λ\)-coalescent, where multiple mergers are allowed, we introduce the~\(Λ\)-broadcast voter model, in which a voter may transmit its opinion simultaneously to several neighbors according to a mechanism governed by a finite measure~\(Λ\) on~\([0,1]\); the classical voter model is recovered when~\(Λ=δ_0\).
